title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, templates, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, tool-calling templates, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide engineers with production-ready examples for building agents that use the Redwood API, call external tools, and safely integrate retrieval components. This PR includes: 1) RAG agent templates (Python + TypeScript) that show structured tool calls, error handling, and KV/prefix caching hints; 2) a tool-calling quickstart that wires up a mock search/alembic tool and a simple scheduler; 3) docs site pages and quickstart walkthroughs with code samples and screenshots; 4) example test harnesses and CI e2e smoke tests. Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart and template - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and template - [x] Add docs site pages and navigation entries - [x] Add minimal e2e smoke tests for examples - [x] Update README and quickstart badges - [x] Add Linear/Jira links in pr body Notes: kept diffs small and focused on examples/docs only; no runtime binary or infra changes. See linked Linear tickets for follow-ups and roadmap items.
